title: Milwaukee expense trip maps to a real USC4AM event
summary: Official event records materially corroborate the stated conference purpose, while attendee and reimbursement records remain unresolved.

data.claim: A real USC4AM conference occurred in Milwaukee in May 2023 and is consistent with the conference purpose attributed to the Carlson-Woodward trip; official attendee confirmation and expense compliance are not established.
data.adjudication: Event existence confirmed; individual attendance and charged-item validity require primary county records.
